vars.name: a5_front_collapsed
vars.derive: front.north == collapsed OR front.east == collapsed OR front.south == collapsed OR front.ring == collapsed OR front.rear == collapsed
vars.label: var.a5_front_collapsed

vars.name: a6_gods_out
vars.derive: verdict.eluen IN (voluntary, judged) AND verdict.valda IN (voluntary, judged) AND verdict.merca IN (voluntary, judged) AND verdict.sylvie IN (voluntary, judged) AND verdict.moira IN (voluntary, judged)
vars.label: var.a6_gods_out

vars.name: a6_holdouts
vars.derive: COUNT(verdict.eluen IN (refuse, contend), verdict.valda IN (refuse, contend), verdict.merca IN (refuse, contend), verdict.sylvie IN (refuse, contend), verdict.moira IN (refuse, contend))
vars.label: var.a6_holdouts

vars.name: a6_release_bar
vars.derive: a5_purify_success AND NOT a5_front_collapsed AND a5_held_unaided >= 3 AND a5_janu_act == receive AND continent >= 50 AND a6_review_score >= 0.6 AND autonomy >= 60
vars.label: var.a6_release_bar

vars.name: a6_release_core
vars.derive: a6_gods_out AND a6_janu_release AND NOT a6_player_absorb AND NOT a6_god_war
vars.label: var.a6_release_core
